mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (type, target_type, target_id, user_id) VALUES (#{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.is_read, n.created_at, COALESCE(q1.title, q2.title) AS question_title, c.content AS comment FROM notification n LEFT JOIN question q1 ON n.type = 'ANSWER_CREATED' AND n.target_id = q1.question_id LEFT JOIN comment c ON n.type = 'COMMENT_CREATED' AND n.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN answer a ON c.answer_id = a.answer_id LEFT JOIN question q2 ON a.question_id = q2.question_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.is_read ASC, n.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE is_read = false AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = true WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = false
